extracted.intended_audience: government communication professionals (Cabinet Office / Government Communication Service / MCOM function)
extracted.subtask_description: A government MCOM function guide describing stages of engagement and the communication interventions appropriate to policy, operational and crisis problems. It lays out diagnosis, agreement, delivery and learning stages for strategic communications work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy operations crisis problem stages (and communication interventions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Overarching framing of the engagement framework: identifies problem stages (policy, operations, crisis) and pairs them with appropriate communication interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the high-level organising principle for the MCOM function guide; groups subsequent stages and interventions under the umbrella of 'problem stages and communication interventions'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy and operational diagnosis
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy and operational diagnosis (Strategic communications advice)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stage focused on diagnosing policy and operational problems and providing strategic communications advice to inform decisions and options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreed diagnosis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stage where stakeholders reach an agreed understanding of the problem and the communications diagnosis is confirmed to guide subsequent activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy and operational delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy and operational delivery (Operational and delivery communication)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stage focused on implementing policy and operational decisions with supporting communication activity (operational and delivery communications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment and learning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stage for assessing outcomes, capturing lessons and translating them into strategic communications guidance for future work.
